nodes.description: A patent document titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of the patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting diagnosis through similarity matching of medical cases and experts.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, allows selection between query-for-cases and query-for-experts, and returns subsets based on computed similarity.

A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are represented as multidimensional embeddings.<SEP>A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.<SEP>A medical case submitted by a requester as part of a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used for similarity comparison.<SEP>A set of previously stored medical cases that are embedded in the embedding space and compared against a new medical case to return a similar subset.

A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be matched to a new case and attempt to provide a diagnosis.<SEP>A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profile, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.

A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from available query types.

A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.
A structure comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, used to compute multidimensional representations of medical cases and experts, with each concept corresponding to a dimension.
A medical ontology on which the embedding of medical cases and experts is based.
A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of a new case when computing similarity, accounting for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
The outcome sought for a new medical case, which an expert attempts to provide.<SEP>The medical determination that an expert attempts to formulate for a new medical case provided to the expert.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when a query-for-experts is selected.

A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up a new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.
A database from which documents are returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents when a query-for-cases is selected.

A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions to assist with diagnosis.<SEP>A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.
A component in communication with the memory that executes the stored instructions.
A component that stores instructions for receiving queries, embedding cases, providing query types, returning subsets, and computing costs.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
A representation of a medical case or expert generated in the embedding space.

edges.description: The patent US9589231B2 describes a method for diagnosis assistance exploiting similarity between medical cases and experts.
The diagnosis assistance method embeds a new medical case in an embedding space in which existing medical cases and experts are also embedded.
The diagnosis assistance method receives a query request including a new medical case and processes it.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-cases among a plurality of query types.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-experts among a plurality of query types.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor for executing the instructions.
The computer program product stores instructions that when executed cause a computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
At least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps is performed with a computer processor.
The new medical case is embedded in an embedding space.
The set of existing medical cases is embedded in the embedding space.
The set of experts is embedded in the embedding space.
Multidimensional representations of existing cases, experts, and the new case are generated in the embedding space.
The embedding of the new medical case comprises computing a multidimensional representation based on a medical ontology.
A matrix of proximities is applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case when computing the similarity measure.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records relating to a specific patient.
The requester submits a query request that includes a new medical case.
The new case is communicated to one of the subset of experts for the expert to attempt to provide a diagnosis.

When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the existing medical cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.
The embedding of the existing medical cases is based on the medical ontology.
When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.
The embedding of the set of experts is based on the medical ontology.
When the query-for-experts is selected, provision is made for making a payment to the expert for formulating the diagnosis.
The user devices link experts with the system.
An expert from the subset of experts attempts to provide a diagnosis for the new case.
The requester is provided the option to select the query-for-cases query type.
The requester is provided the option to select the query-for-experts query type.
The user devices link requesters with the system.

The cost for a query-for-cases differs from the cost for a query-for-experts.<SEP>The query-by-cases is provided at a first cost.<SEP>The computed query cost is lower for a query-for-cases than for a query-for-experts.
When the query-by-cases is selected, provision is made for a query-by-experts to be performed subsequent to the query-by-cases.
When the query-for-cases is selected, documents from a public database are returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents.

The cost for a query-for-experts is different from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>The query-by-experts is provided at a second cost higher than the first cost.<SEP>The computed query cost is higher for a query-for-experts than for a query-for-cases.
When the query-for-experts is selected, the new case is provided to a selected expert for formulating a diagnosis.
The medical ontology is based on the Unified Medical Language System.
The matrix of proximities accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises memory which stores instructions.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
The network comprises a system for diagnosis assistance.
The processor is in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
The network comprises a set of user devices.
